AMZN.reasoning:
MACRO REGIME: Mixed-to-cautiously-bullish. Nasdaq hit an intraday ATH on May 5 (partial risk-on recovery), but the Iran-UAE/Strait of Hormuz conflict is unresolved with oil above $102/bbl sustaining inflation. Fed holds at 3.5-3.75% with hawkish Warsh succession risk on May 15. The regime supports growth/tech broadly but carries an active left-tail geopolitical risk that has not been removed. This is a transitional, not clean risk-on, regime.

PRIOR CALL ADJUSTMENT: My May 4 bearish call (entry $271.85, stop $276.10) was stopped out same day. The prior short thesis assumed April 30 shooting-star distribution would lead to immediate bearish continuation. What the stop-out proves: bulls absorbed and broke the $268-$276 distribution zone. I must not repeat the bearish mean-reversion thesis from current levels without a new catalyst. Thesis revision: bulls have short-term control above $270.

RELATIVE STRENGTH: AMZN is a clear outperformer. 21d ROC = +29.69%, well above broad market. AWS/cloud beat narrative, Amazon earnings strength, and AI capex cycle (Alphabet/Amazon cloud beats noted in wiki macro context) justify the premium. However, the sector rotation timing rule applies: this surge from ~$209 to $276+ is a mature move, not an early-cycle entry. Bullish setups should be taken early in a relative-strength uptrend, not after a 30%+ surge.

ASSYMMETRY MATH: Bullish scenario from $272: nearest resistance $276.10 (volume-confirmed hourly pivot, 4 tests) = +1.5% to first resistance. Extended target at Fib ext 1.272 = $284.65 = +4.6% upside. Stop at hourly support $267.67 (24-test, volume-confirmed) = -1.6% downside. R/R = 4.6% / 1.6% = ~2.9:1 technically sufficient, BUT the immediate resistance at $276.10 limits the first leg. If $276 caps, true net upside before stop = only 1.5% vs 1.6% risk = 0.9:1 (unfavorable). The asymmetry is conditional on clearing $276 — which bulls haven't confirmed yet.

CAPITAL PRESERVATION FLAGS: Daily RSI-14 = 80.49, RSI-21 = 90.43 — extreme overbought. Z-score vs 50-SMA = 2.06 standard deviations. Price is 20.36% above 50-SMA. 21d ROC = +29.69%. These are historically reverting levels. Hourly volume bias (10d) is DOWN — potential distribution signal even as price holds. ATR 2.66% daily (meaningful stop distance required). No balance sheet leverage concern (AMZN is cash-rich) — capital preservation flag is statistical/vol-based, not fundamental.

SECTOR CYCLE TIMING: We are LATE in the AMZN relative-strength uptrend. Entry here would be chasing, not leading. The setup that would warrant a bullish entry is a pullback to the $260-$267 zone (20-21 EMA / hourly support cluster) with RSI cooling to 55-65 and hourly volume bias turning up — none of those conditions are met today.

VERDICT: Macro supports tech/cloud broadly, AMZN fundamentals are sound, but: (1) prior bearish call stopped out — bulls proved control, so I will not fade this trend without new evidence; (2) asymmetry for a long chase here is marginal-to-poor at current $272-273 given $276 resistance; (3) extreme overbought readings + declining hourly volume = elevated reversal risk if regime deteriorates; (4) geopolitical left tail (Strait of Hormuz) could shock high-beta growth names. Neutral: not bearish (bulls have control), not bullish (no clean 2:1+ entry from here). Wait for a pullback.
